text:
ITEM 1 | Loose bed of dark green, deeply lobed leaves with thin pale stems, spread across the left half of the plate, leaves slightly glossy with light dressing sheen; footprint about 35% of plate diameter-wide area, roughly 8 cm tall mounded pile | 60
ITEM 2 | Thin slices of pale pink-to-white root vegetable with a bright pink rim, one slice about 4 cm across, lying on top of the greens near the top edge of the plate; firm, smooth, slightly translucent edges | 15
ITEM 3 | Scattered whole and halved almonds, light tan with brown skins, two or three visible among the greens near the top; small, about 1 cm each | 5
ITEM 4 | Cubes of pan-browned tofu, golden-tan crusted outside with pale interior, cubes roughly 2.5 cm, sitting on the right side of the plate; firm, slightly crisp edges, dry surface | 70
ITEM 5 | Mound of cooked brown-reddish whole grain (rice-like), slightly sticky and separate grains, mixed with bits of green herb and small red pepper pieces, filling the center-right area about 6 cm across and 2 cm high; matte, moist-looking | 90
ITEM 6 | Small pieces of diced red bell pepper and bright green chopped herb or scallion scattered through the grain and tofu, shiny and slightly wilted; small amount | 10
ITEM 7 | Thin orange shreds (carrot-like) scattered on the greens and near the radish slice, bright orange, about 1 cm long; small amount | 3
